items.excerpt: A new AI smart ring is promising continuous blood-pressure monitoring — a health metric Apple and Oura still won't commit to — pushing AI-driven smart-ring health tracking into new territory.
Ahead of the July 22 Unpacked, Samsung's foldables are set to debut new Galaxy AI features like Gemini-powered real-time Scam Detection across the Z Fold 8 and Z Flip 8.
Samsung confirmed its July 22 Galaxy Unpacked for the Z Fold 8 series and Watch 9, with Galaxy AI on-device features expected front and center.

OpenAI unveiled its first hardware product — the $230 Codex Micro, a programmable macro pad made with Work Louder for its AI coding agent, with 13 mechanical switches, a touch sensor, rotary dial, and joystick.
OpenAI's Codex Micro, a $230 keypad developed with keyboard maker Work Louder, has six frosted keys with LEDs that track the status of Codex agents plus a dial to adjust reasoning level.
Per Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, OpenAI's Jony Ive device collaboration will reportedly be a screenless smart speaker with mechanical components that can move, designed to act as an AI companion.

Google Home is rolling out visual enhancements for weather and sports on smart displays, and Gemini's voice assistant now handles back-to-back commands more reliably without interrupting for voice verification.

Nothing's shipping $99 Ear (3a) earbuds add an on-device Audio Snapshot recorder — pinch to capture up to 60 seconds — with AI transcription, summaries and speaker ID in the Nothing X app, plus ChatGPT integration.
